Fury & Grudges

Doesn't explode on contact — it keeps the boil going for as long as it takes, and only detonates once it's been made to stop, cut off, ignored mid-tirade. Its punishments always land exactly when patience finally runs out, never a moment sooner.

Areas of Concern fury, grudges, the boil-over

Edicts never let a slight go unanswered forever, even if the answer waits; finish what you start saying

Anathema apologize first; let someone else have the last word

Religious Symbol a raised fist mid-swing, frozen

Sacred Animal wasp

Sacred Colors scorch black, ember orange
